subject: Error: Unable to deploy using default arguments (multiple existing deployments from this application directory already exist).

messages.author: f6a8c19550968075
messages.subject: Error: Unable to deploy using default arguments (multiple existing deployments from this application directory already exist).
parts:
Here's the full error message I get after entering deployApp() into RStudio with my Shiny project open: "Error: Unable to deploy using default arguments (multiple existing deployments from this application directory already exist). Please specify appName and/or account name explicitly."

I've tried specifying the appName and account name explicitly, but I get the same message. The issue may be that I've deployed the app from computers at two different locations. I'm not sure what to do except deploy a second app, but that seems like an especially wasteful solution.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error: Unable to deploy using default arguments (multiple existing deployments from this application directory already exist).
parts:
Hi Reed,
Is it possible that you have more than one application in the directory that you are deploying from? I am guessing all you need to specify is the appName and not your account name since most people only have access to one account in the alpha.

-Tareef
